  <h1>ChroMods</h1>
  <p>Chrome MV3 theming mods for YouTube, GitHub, Google Search, Gmail, Gemini, DuckDuckGo, X, Twitch, and ChatGPT.<br/>Styles adapted from <a href="https://github.com/sameerasw/my-internet">my-internet</a>.</p>

The popup detects the active tab and shows that site's mods first. Search the header to jump to a site or mod. A moon/sun toggle can force dark mode on **any website** (Dark Reader engine), with per-site brightness, contrast, sepia, and grayscale in Settings. Sites that already ship a native dark theme are left alone by default. Keyboard shortcuts live in the same settings panel. Unsupported sites get a compact tag and a **Request styling** action that opens a GitHub issue (or an existing one) on this repo.

## Features

### <img src="docs/sites/youtube.svg" width="22" height="22" alt="" /> YouTube

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Smooth blur and zoom effect when focusing the search bar. | On |
| **Feed layout fix** | Denser home feed that follows the feed width, or a fixed column count. | On |
| **Hide filter chips** | Remove the category chip bar and header row on the home feed. | On |
| **Thumbnail hover** | Enlarge inline video previews after hovering a thumbnail. | Off |
| **Hide distractions** | Remove Shorts shelves, merch shelves, and legacy annotations. | Off |
| **Compact sidebar** | Icon-only guide sidebar with a cleaner, minimal layout. | On |
| **Hide side guide** | Completely remove YouTube's side navigation. | Off |
| **Clean side guide** | Hide Studio, Sports, Settings, and footer links from the guide. | Off |
| **Theater mode** | Full-window theater view with configurable comments panel. | On |
| **Player blur** | Frosted-glass blur on video player controls and menus. | On |
| **Disable ambient mode** | Remove YouTube's cinematic ambient glow behind the player. | Off |
| **Better captions** | Use a compact frosted caption panel with clearer text. | Off |
| **YouTube TV** | Polish the large-screen YouTube TV player and overlays. | Off |
| **Overlay live chat** | Float live chat at the right edge while in theater mode. | Off |
| **Movable live chat** | Drag, resize, and adjust live chat opacity in theater mode. | Off |

### <img src="docs/sites/github.svg" width="22" height="22" alt="" /> GitHub

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Blur and zoom the page when focusing the header search bar. | On |
| **Hover sidebars** | Hide the home-feed left and right sidebars until you hover them. | Off |
| **No tab text** | Repository tabs show icons only; labels appear on hover. | On |
| **Repo sidebar hover** | Collapse the repository About sidebar until you hover it. | Off |
| **Hide footer** | Hide GitHub's page footer. | On |
| **Hide toolbar separator** | Remove the divider in the header actions toolbar. | On |
| **Glass effect** | Frosted-glass look on buttons, comments, editors, and cards. | On |
| **Softer borders** | Drop table borders and round file, tab, and header edges. | On |
| **Remove button borders** | Strip borders from secondary buttons, inputs, and the branch bar. | On |
| **Timeline badges** | Give issue and pull-request timeline icons a clearer glass background. | On |
| **Chip spacing** | Add breathing room around overview chips and the Copilot menu button. | On |

### <img src="docs/sites/google.svg" width="22" height="22" alt="" /> Google

| Mod | What it does | Default |
|-----|--------------|---------|
| **Immersive search** | Blur and scale the results page when the search box is focused. | On |
| **Hover filter chips** | Hide the Images and search filter chip row until you hover it. | Off |
| **Glass search bar** | Inset glass on the search box and a softer AI Overview panel. | On |

Applies to Search only — Gmail, Docs, and other Google apps are left alone.

## Install

1. Clone this repo → `chrome://extensions` → **Developer mode** → **Load unpacked** → repo root
2. Reload any open YouTube, GitHub, Google Search, Gmail, Gemini, DuckDuckGo, X, Twitch, and ChatGPT tabs

## Dev

```bash
npm install          # playwright for e2e
npm test             # manifest, CSS compatibility, and wiring
npm run test:e2e     # popup UI, theater geometry, and YouTube injection
npm run readme       # regenerate this README from live feature metadata
```

Chromium only. Zen browser-window transparency is excluded because Chromium cannot expose the chrome backdrop. Settings sync under `chroModsSettings`.
